conviction_note: Nothing decisive and nothing pre-released. The Q3 numbers are new, but HEBA is a low-volatility Stockholm residential landlord: 18% realised vol, observed report-day moves of about 0.2-2.7%, and the 2026-2030 targets were already published as insider information on 09-08, so no guidance change is expected. Two small positive leans: a peer (Wallenstam) reported flat residential yields and large derivative gains for Q3, and the 1%-capped buyback is nearly exhausted, so the report is a natural place to renew it. That gives p_up 54 on a 3.0% scale (+0.24). The findings sum is +0.5 because each lean is sized on its own; that gap is expected and needs no fixing.

findings.finding: Closest listed residential peer Wallenstam's Q3 2026 report (15 Oct) says residential yields changed only marginally (3.7% for residential in operation). Its Q3 property value change was +107 mkr, mainly from projects, and its rate derivatives gained +578 mkr in the quarter. Read across: HEBA's Q3 value line is likely flat to small positive (not a repeat of Q3 2025's -20.8 mkr) and its derivative line positive.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 printed a -20.8 mkr property value change with förvaltningsresultat up 7.5%, and the stock fell 2.58% on 2025-10-22. H1 2026 printed +150 mkr in value changes and the stock rose 2.73% on 2026-07-09 (Yahoo daily closes).

findings.why_not_priced: The peer report is public, but it is not HEBA's own number: valuers differ, a third of HEBA's portfolio is valued externally each quarter, and HEBA has a care-home segment. Had the market carried this into HEBA, HEBA would have moved with Wallenstam. Wallenstam rose 2.78% on its report day; HEBA was -0.64% that day (23.30 on 10-15) and then +2.1% on 10-16, so at most part of it is in the price. This is a peer proxy, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: HEBA's own H1 report already judged residential values 'oförändrad' (unchanged) in Q2 on unchanged yields (https://storage.mfn.se/b76eaa06-2624-4af6-add0-339bc46b7f05/heba-delarsrapport-jan-jun-2026.pdf). The Riksbank held its policy rate at 1.75% in September (https://via.tt.se/ir-files/3236667/4565143/7084/Penningpolitiskt%20beslut%20september%202026%2C%20Beslut%20om%20styrr%C3%A4nta.pdf).

findings.finding: The buyback program is nearly used up: 1,408,427 of its 1,651,200-share cap bought by 16 Oct, leaving about 243k shares, roughly four sessions at the 52-61k shares/day pace (about 25% of volume). The AGM mandate allows treasury holdings up to 10% (now 6.85%), and the stock trades near 46% of a rough EPRA-style equity per share, so the Q3 report is the natural place for the board to announce a continuation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The program launch was announced 2026-08-21 at 18:00; the stock rose 1.44% on the next session (2026-08-24). The Q3 2025 report carried a buyback line ('återköpt ytterligare 4,9 miljoner egna B-aktier', a further 4.9m B shares bought back) and the stock still fell 2.58% that day.
findings.original_quote: Sedan Återköpsprogrammet inleddes den 24 augusti 2026 har sammanlagt 1 408 427 aktier av serie B återköpts inom programmet ... inom en ram om högst 1 651 200 aktier av serie B (Since the program began on 24 August 2026, a total of 1,408,427 B shares have been bought back within the program, out of a maximum of 1,651,200 B shares)
findings.why_not_priced: Whether there will be a renewal is not public and no source says it. If the market expected one, the price would not show the 5-day run-up coinciding with the buyback's rising daily prints (23.06 to 23.75); that is the program itself, not anticipation of more. If no renewal comes, a quarter of daily demand disappears around 22 Oct, after this window closes. Inference, so sized small; the wide upper range is the renewal case.
findings.independence: The 09-08 Hebamodellen release names buybacks as a capital-allocation tool: 'behålla, investera, sälja, amortera, dela ut eller återköpa' (keep, invest, sell, amortise, pay out or buy back) (https://mfn.se/a/heba-fastighets/heba-hojer-ambitionsnivan-nya-finansiella-mal-och-ny-affarsmodell). The AGM 2026 mandate is in https://mfn.se/a/heba-fastighets/kommunike-fran-arsstamma-2026-i-heba-fastighets-ab.

findings.finding: Stockholm city's 2027 private-landlord rent level went to arbitration, and the arbitrator recommended +2.85% from 1 Jan 2027: below the roughly 3-3.5% Stockholm-region outcome for 2026 and well above the tenant union's roughly 1% forecast. HEBA (74% residential rent, all in Stockholm/Mälardalen) may quantify its 2027 rent uplift in the report.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed HEBA reaction to a rent-negotiation line. Peers rose 2-3% on 14-16 Oct around the announcement, as did HEBA (+1.5% on 10-14, +2.1% on 10-16).
